name: 02-capabilities
teaches: One program, two apps: with no config every call is denied, and with a config that wires fs to a directory the same three calls answer ok, refused-on-the-resolved-path, and denied.
cmd: echo '$ drt run app.dlua'; drt run app.dlua; echo; echo '$ drt run --config with-fs.json'; drt run --config with-fs.json
